author: reek
body: Walks a supersession chain the fixture actually built. The starting hash has to be one the fixture produced: this test used to walk from the literal "hash-a", which matches no annotation in the repo, so the walk returned a single placeholder step and the assertions below could not have failed for any reason to do with walking.

author: reek
body: The cycle case is the loop guard's only evidence. Two annotations that supersede each other have no tip, so a walk with no revisit check is bounded only by max-chain-depth and reports 64 steps; with the guard it stops the moment it meets a hash it has already walked, at 2.
